what_happened: main CI went red on a 68-error ruff backlog (62 auto-fixable) across the scribe modules and others. Recurring rule classes: UP045 (typing.Optional[X] should be X | None when 'from __future__ import annotations' is present; also drop the now-unused Optional import); B904 (inside an except block, re-raise with 'raise ... from exc' or 'from None'); PIE810 (s.startswith('/') or s.startswith('~') should be s.startswith(('/','~')); same for endswith); SIM103 (return the boolean condition directly instead of 'if cond: return False / return True'); SIM108 (use a ternary instead of if/else assigning one variable); SIM105 (use contextlib.suppress(OSError) instead of try/except OSError/pass); plus unsorted imports (I-rules). Cleared 78 with 'ruff check --fix' + 'ruff format', then 6 manual idiom fixes (notably B904 chained with 'from exc' to preserve the cause, NOT the auto-fixer default 'from None'). 968 tests still passed; behavior preserved.
what_learned: Write in ruff-clean idioms from the start so CI stays green: modern union annotations under future-annotations, chained raises in except, tuple-arg startswith/endswith, direct boolean returns, ternaries, contextlib.suppress, sorted imports. BEFORE pushing to sovereign-stack run the CI gate locally: 'venv/bin/python -m ruff check src/sovereign_stack/ tests/ && venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check src/sovereign_stack/ tests/'. Most of the backlog auto-fixes; for B904 prefer 'from exc' over the auto-fixer's 'from None' to keep the exception cause. This is the same recurrence the chronicle already noted in Wave 6 — docs/lint drift is maintenance, not surprise.
